id: 07_Clean and Organized is Laser Safety Wise Laser Maintenance Group Innovative Lase
title: 整洁有序也是安全
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/07_Clean and Organized is Laser Safety Wise Laser Maintenance Group Innovative Lase.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/07_Clean and Organized is Laser Safety Wise Laser Maintenance Group Innovative Lase/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着扫帚站在整洁的车间通道上，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a broom in a tidy workshop aisle and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 整洁有序，也是安全。

shots.scene: 通道、线缆、废料桶、格栅台、废料架五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a clear aisle, a coiled cable, a scrap bin, a grid table and a scrap rack. No people.
shots.narration: 跟老李在车间里走一圈。

shots.scene: 办公区门口，老李对着镜头讲话，几位访客在旁
shots.prompt_en: At an office door with a blank welcome sign, the facility engineer talks to the camera with a few visitors nearby.
shots.narration: 客户来了，都想进车间看看。

shots.scene: 老李推开门，带访客走进车间
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pushes open the door and leads the visitors into the workshop.
shots.narration: 带他们进来，就要照看好他们。

shots.scene: 激光图标旁加一个扫帚图标，中间画等号连到盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A laser icon and a broom icon joined by an equals sign to a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 今天讲的不是激光，是整理整顿。

shots.scene: 老李竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer raises one finger while talking.
shots.narration: 整理整顿，同样是安全。

shots.scene: 干净的通道，地面扫得发亮
shots.prompt_en: A clean workshop aisle with a freshly swept shiny floor. No people.
shots.narration: 通道要保持干净，扫干净。

shots.scene: 软管和电缆挂在墙上的挂钩上，地面空着
shots.prompt_en: Hoses and cables hang on wall hooks and the floor below is clear. No people.
shots.narration: 软管、电缆都不放在地上。

shots.scene: 家和办公室的图标，旁边一个车间图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a home and an office next to an icon of an industrial workshop. No people.
shots.narration: 访客习惯的是家里和办公室。

shots.scene: 工作台尽头摞着几个白色废料桶，尖角从桶口伸出
shots.prompt_en: At the end of a blue workbench, several white scrap bins are stacked, with sharp metal pieces sticking out. No people.
shots.narration: 工作台尽头，摞着几个废料桶。

shots.scene: 老李弯腰指着桶口伸出的尖角
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer bends down and points with a bare hand at the sharp scrap sticking out of a bin.
shots.narration: 图方便放在这儿，废料却伸了出来。

shots.scene: 一个边走边张望的人图标，腿碰到伸出的尖角
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person looking around while walking, whose leg hits a sharp corner sticking out. No people.
shots.narration: 边走边看的人不看脚下，就会被扎。

shots.scene: 折弯机和激光机上方画着声音波纹，人的视线都朝上
shots.prompt_en: A press brake and a laser machine with sound wave lines above them, and eye icons all looking up at them. No people.
shots.narration: 大家都在看会响的折弯机和激光机。

shots.scene: 脚下的线缆和废料图标旁一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A cable and scrap pieces on the floor next to a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 没人会去看脚下。

shots.scene: 畅通的通道和挂起的线缆打勾
shots.prompt_en: A clear aisle and cables hung off the floor, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 所以通道畅通、线缆离地很重要。

shots.scene: 老李走到激光切割机的格栅工作台旁
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks to the slatted grid table of a laser cutting machine.
shots.narration: 到了激光切割机旁边。

shots.scene: 人靠在激光机上的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person leaning against a laser machine, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要站在这儿，靠在激光机上。

shots.scene: 格栅条上一排锯齿状的尖顶特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the jagged pointed tips along the slats of the grid table. No people.
shots.narration: 格栅条是用来托住板材的。

shots.scene: 手搭在格栅条上的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand resting on the grid slats, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 把手搭在上面，会被划伤。

shots.scene: 有人爬上工作台的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person climbing onto the laser cutting bed, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 更不要爬上激光机的工作台。

shots.scene: 老李回忆，旁边一个日历翻回多年前
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer recalls a story, with a calendar flipping back many years beside him.
shots.narration: 多年前，有人摔在台面上。

shots.scene: 一个缝针的医疗图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple medical stitches icon with a bandage. No people.
shots.narration: 伤得很重，缝了大约60针。

shots.scene: 蓝色废料架前，散乱的废料图标
shots.prompt_en: In front of a blue scrap rack, an icon of messy scattered scrap. No people.
shots.narration: 废料管理真的很难，很容易乱。

shots.scene: 大块废料骨架竖着插在架子里
shots.prompt_en: Large leftover sheet skeletons stand upright in slots of a blue scrap rack. No people.
shots.narration: 大块废料骨架，竖着放进架子。

shots.scene: 老李拉起链条，把废料挂住
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls up a chain across the rack and latches it.
shots.narration: 再用链条挂住锁定，倒不出来。

shots.scene: 架子上方伸出一截板材边角，正好在头部高度
shots.prompt_en: A sheet metal corner sticks out from the top of the rack at head height. No people.
shots.narration: 架子上方伸出来的板材边角，

shots.scene: 老李伸手比到自己头部的高度
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds his hand at the level of his own head next to the sticking-out corner.
shots.narration: 正好在头这么高，容易碰头。

shots.scene: 板边被切掉、收进架内的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: the sticking-out corner is trimmed off and the rest is pushed back into the rack. No people.
shots.narration: 这种东西要切掉，或者收进去。

shots.scene: 废料按类别整齐放好的架子
shots.prompt_en: A scrap rack with scrap sorted neatly by type and safely put away. No people.
shots.narration: 废料分类整齐，安全收好。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现通道、线缆、废料桶、格栅、废料架图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside icons of a clear aisle, cables off the floor, a scrap bin, a grid table and a scrap rack.
shots.narration: 通道畅通，线缆离地，废料不伸出。

shots.scene: 老李站在整齐的废料架前点头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer nods in front of the neat, chained scrap rack.
shots.narration: 别靠别爬，废料锁好，板边收好。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥着扫帚告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves the broom goodbye.
shots.narration: 整洁有序就是安全，下次见！
